notes: Input pack explicitly targets2026 AHC100; asset uses that source, not a generic upgrade of2016/2021campaign.
Default map is Smoke and Mirrors. Other two actual campaign layout variants are independent SVG/JSON; choosing a layout does not auto-progress the campaign.
All player stations remain full; source illustrations are original neutral card/token geometry without card text/characters/logos.
No artificial fixed location capacity or movement grid; changing map/card states carry exact coordinates/directed edges/rotation/layers/attachments.
Unseen card backs and shuffled sewer card identities are never filled with assumed answers.
Asset completion and later Claude application integration are separate.

structureEvidence.access: 48page source retained; table/components/test diagrams directly rendered and viewed, relevant state text read
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: 1–4players,5investigator choices; new connector/investigator tokens; separate deck types; exact token groups/denominations; four full investigator tableaus; readiness versusface/ownership/engagement/attachments/test/campaign state.

structureEvidence.access: downloaded16pages; actual map diagrams pp7/12directly viewed; setup p3read
structureEvidence.location: p3SpreadingFlames single starting location; p7nine-location map/11arrow links; p12seven-position sewer map and shuffled backs/current side icons
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: Three distinct real layouts. Do not use Night of the Zealot/The Gathering. Queen tunnel identities shuffled; shown-side links may change after reveal.

assetScope: AHC100 full1–4investigator table with three base-campaign location templates, every public/private deck/hand/threat/asset/token/test/campaign-state structure. Assets only.

tableModel.edition: 2026 ChapterTwo core AHC100; Brethren of Ash. Prior2016/2021scenario maps are not substituted.

mapTemplate.coordinatePolicy: No fixed card-slot capacity. Each physical card retains its own ID/face/x/y/rotation/layer/attachments. Add/remove/move cards and connector token instances without inventing adjacency from spacing.
mapTemplate.hiddenPolicy: Queen tunnel positions are shuffled backs. IDs are position IDs, NOT secret revealed card identities; names/contents remain unknown until actually revealed.
mapTemplate.dynamicPolicy: Recompute or explicitly record directed connections from currently shown card icons and card-specific exceptions when a card flips/moves/appears/disappears. Initial graph is not a universal later-game graph. Links may be one-way; undirected diagram arrows here are stored as both.

coordinates.playerStations: two rows of two independent full investigator tableaus; presentation layout not fixed rules inventory

identityInvariants: One physical enemy card is on the map when unengaged OR in a threat area when engaged; locationId follows the investigator, not a duplicated enemy. Massive enemy multi-engagement stores several investigator IDs on the same card.
A mini-card/token depicts the investigator on the map without duplicating the investigator character card. Alternative lead token representation is explicit.
Ready/exhausted orientation and card face are independent. Flipping a location may change edges; preserve actual active side.
Committed cards leave hand for the current test, remain linked to owners, and are discarded/returned only after the recorded effect resolves.
Chaos token composition, currently revealed tokens and boxed unused tokens are disjoint physical collections. Do not return tokens twice on resume.
Double-sided clue/doom tokens are single instances with denomination and face, not separate inventories. Unknown card/token counts remain null.
tableModel.visibility: Owner hand/deck and unrevealed cards stay scoped. Known title of an unrevealed location does not reveal its back text or shuffled identity. Public discards per investigator are inspectable; set-aside secrecy depends on the scenario. Hidden weakness/campaign secret choices never copied into public notes.

fieldBindings.map.scene: public location graph, scenario decks, map investigators/enemies and tokens
fieldBindings.hidden.scene: physical-only hidden deck metadata, no fabricated catalog binding

tableModel.ruleAutomation: No full card database, card-text/effect engine, legality, hidden-card inference, automatic scenario progress or campaign rewards. The asset can represent changing card graphs/attachments/visibility and exact checkpoints without resolving them.

completeStructures: dynamic directed card connections and physical connectors
notClaimed: automatic later-side graph after unrecorded flip
